Data:Do.record.scale.json.label: Make a Determination: Shell Origin
Data:Do.record.scale.json.startdescription: The Carapace Cross are a hybrid race, and once we were the Carapace Cross. From the Seglaz-kind, we inherited what now we call language. We long for what we were; and History too is hybrid. [Adds Scale and Heart to your journal; replaces any other Origin Determination. Adding Determinations to your Journal makes it first possible, then easier, to write a matching History.]
Data:Do.record.scale.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and I have made my Determination. [If you're considering a Scale History, the First Flower: Black Determination is relevant; or if you're considering a Heart History, Oldest: Horned-Axe is relevant.]

Data:Do.record.sky.json.label: Make a Determination: From-Nowhere Origin
Data:Do.record.sky.json.startdescription: The Thritige-kind of the Carapace Cross dreamed themselves out of black glass, to be their own Monarch. If we inherit the empty throne, we dream ourselves into every night to come. [Adds Sky and Forge to your journal; replaces any other Origin Determination. Adding Determinations to your Journal makes it first possible, then easier, to write a matching History.]
Data:Do.record.sky.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and I have made my Determination. [If you're considering a Sky History, Speech the Key is relevant; or if you're considering a Forge History, First Flower: Red is relevant.]

Data:Do.record.winter.json.label: Make a Determination: White, the First Flower
Data:Do.record.winter.json.startdescription: The Watchman's Tree is the covenant that forbids knowledge to mortals, but permits it in the covenant-houses of the Tree... like Brancrug Isle. The White Flower of Calyptra - 'the silence that is given' was its first defence. When forbidden knowledge is known, it must be forgotten. But to be forgotten, it must first be known. The Tree is rooted in paradox. [Adds Winter and Edge to your journal; replaces any other First Flower Determination. Adding Determinations to your Journal makes it first possible, then easier, to write a matching History.]
Data:Do.record.winter.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and I have made my Determination. [If you're considering a Winter History, Speech the Wound is relevant; or if you're considering an edge History, Speech the Sword is relevant.]

Data:Douglas.json.label: DI Douglas Moore
Data:Douglas.json.desc: Detective-Illuminate of the Suppression Bureau. A stoic, but weary, fellow. His dearest wish is to move to Chingford and grow roses. But the buggers won't let him retire.

xexts.befriend．douglas．hokobald: Douglas has learnt to tolerate Hokobald better than most.

Data:Douglas.likes.arthur.json.desc: Douglas is fond of his newly discovered great-uncle, Arthur.

Data:Douglas.likes.coquille.json.desc: Douglas has a sneaking fondness for Coquille, which he will certainly put aside if he ever has to arrest her.

Data:Douglas.likes.hokobald.json.desc: Douglas has a grudging respect for Hokobald.

Data:Dry.book.killes.json.label: Dry Out a Book
Data:Dry.book.killes.json.startdescription: Mrs Kille, gloomy as always, kind as ever, lights the kitchen fire and helps me dry the book, while Mr Kille saws away in the next room. 'Birth always leaves marks,' she opines, as she carefully tucks fragments of muslin between the damp pages.

Data:Dry.book.rectory.json.label: Dry Out a Book
Data:Dry.book.rectory.json.startdescription: Reverend Timothy is not a man to miss an opportunity for conversation, so the whole business takes longer than it might... but he's anxious to help.

Data:Dry.book.smithy.json.label: Dry Out a Book
Data:Dry.book.smithy.json.startdescription: Denzil watches with grave interest as I dry the book in the warmth of his forge-fire. He provides wads of cotton to put between the pages, but otherwise he keeps his distance. He is wary of the written word. I am beginning to suspect he cannot read. I do not expect he will ever tell me.

Data:Dry.book.sweetbones.json.label: Dry Out a Book
Data:Dry.book.sweetbones.json.startdescription: The clock ticks in the snug; a distant wireless crackles musically; carefully, page by page, I dry the book.
